Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

whistle noun

also blow the whistle, final whistle, starting whistle, whistle a tune

classical

Traupman 45, 406

sībilus, sībilī m.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

whistle, the sound

Neither source has a settled word for the toy whistle.

Other words

  • fistella — whistle (the device)

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. whistle (device) · Wiktionary

    Offered by Morgan–Owens, doubtfully.

Examples

  • sībilum ēmittere

    blow the whistleTraupman 45

  • sībilus fīnālis

    the final whistleTraupman 45

  • sībilus initiālis

    the starting whistleTraupman 45

  • fistulā sībilāre

    to blow the whistleTraupman 406

  • fīnālis (initiālis) sībilus

    the final (starting) whistleTraupman 406

  • sībilāre

    to whistleTraupman 406

  • fistulātō ōre canere

    to whistle a tuneTraupman 406

  • strīdēre

    to whistle (of the wind)Traupman 406

See also referee, bell.
